title: Every answer returns a generic error
description: Hooli Cloud (v3): all questions now return a generic error message. The validation team's rejection counter is climbing. Customer says nothing changed on their side except a nightly docs sync.
provided_evidence: 2025-03-12T10:00:01.920Z INFO ui-r req=req-3a91 tenant=t-hooli latency_ms=1920 status=error

ground_truth.root_cause: v3 requires citations; the tenant's retrieval returns no source metadata (source_ids empty), so validation rejects every response (VAL_REJECT_042).
